title: Weak Authentication
impact: Weak authentication controls may increase unauthorized access risk.
remediation: Strengthen authentication controls and enforce secure password policy.

title: Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Injected browser-side content may affect application users.
remediation: Apply output encoding and validate user-controlled input.

title: Missing Security Header
impact: Missing security headers may reduce browser-side protection.
remediation: Configure the recommended HTTP security headers.

title: Insecure Direct Object Reference
impact: Insufficient authorization may expose another user's resource.
remediation: Enforce server-side authorization for every resource access.

title: Verbose Error Message
impact: Verbose errors may disclose implementation details.
remediation: Return generic client-facing errors and log details securely.

title: Missing Rate Limiting
impact: Lack of rate limiting may increase automated abuse risk.
remediation: Apply appropriate request throttling and account protections.

title: Sensitive Data Exposure
impact: Sensitive information may be disclosed through an application response.
remediation: Limit returned fields and enforce data access controls.

title: Improper Input Validation
impact: Insufficient input validation may allow unexpected application behavior.
remediation: Validate input against strict expected formats and constraints.

title: Session Cookie Misconfiguration
impact: Weak session cookie settings may increase session compromise risk.
remediation: Use Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite cookie settings.

title: Unnecessary Service Exposure
impact: Unnecessary exposed functionality can increase attack surface.
remediation: Disable unused functionality and restrict exposed services.
